verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware security key. It stores credentials on the device itself rather than in a hosted cloud service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this kind of product. The marketing line that passkeys stay 'on your key. Not their cloud' describes fixed on-device storage, not a user-selectable region or residency option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
